author: Richard Gesek
text:
I finally got Abbott to fix my problem with my iPhone 12 using OS 18.3.  I was told by the third technician to delete the app and reload it. This worked for me. It does loose all data but it still resides on LibreView. At least the doctor can still see it. Honestly I’ve posted quite a few complaints about this in the past but I’m grateful to Abbot for finally fixing the problem. I’m still on their red list as in the past especially with FreeStyle Libre 2 I’ve had multiple sensor faults and fall offs. They say I’ve reached the limit of replacements. As I pay cash for my sensors I’m not too happy about it that but I still believe the sensors helped me go from a 8.5 A1C to 6.1. 
Maybe after a while they will take me off the red list.
